about_the_game:
This is a short demo for the beta version of MineMogul.

It's currently very rough and unpolished. The demo will improve overtime as we build out a full early access version of the game.

Current limitations with the demo:

  • No saving/loading

  • Placeholder UI (Menus, Hud, etc)

  • Very basic animations and sounds

We're happy to hear your feedback and will be constantly improving the demo based on your input!
